features.name: Minnehaha Falls
features.description: The 53-foot falls are viewed from accessible upper overlooks; lower viewpoints require stairs and gorge paths that become wet, icy, or closed.

features.name: Sea Salt Eatery
features.description: Sea Salt Eatery operates seasonally beside the falls pavilion with seafood, drinks, and long peak-time lines; park access does not guarantee restaurant service.

features.name: Lower Glen Trail
features.description: Lower Glen Trail follows Minnehaha Creek toward the Mississippi through steep, shaded gorge terrain with stairs, roots, mud, and limited facilities.

features.name: Wabun Playground and Wading Pool
features.description: Wabun combines an accessible playground, seasonal wading pool, picnic facilities, disc golf, and a river overlook in the park's southeastern zone.

features.name: Longfellow Gardens
features.description: Longfellow Gardens sit above the highway tunnel across from the main park, offering free formal plantings and a quieter wedding setting.
